name: Trade Data 44
definition: Provides information and details on the status of a trade.

OriginatorReference.name: Originator Reference
OriginatorReference.definition: Represents the original reference of the instruction for which the status is given, as assigned by the participant that submitted the foreign exchange trade.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique system identification assigned to the trade by the central matching system.

MatchingSystemMatchingReference.name: Matching System Matching Reference
MatchingSystemMatchingReference.definition: Reference to the unique matching identification assigned to the trade and to the matching trade from the counterparty by the central matching system.

MatchingSystemMatchedSideReference.name: Matching System Matched Side Reference
MatchingSystemMatchedSideReference.definition: Unique reference from the central settlement system that allows the removal of alleged trades once the matched status notification for the matching side has been received.

CurrentSettlementDate.name: Current Settlement Date
CurrentSettlementDate.definition: The current settlement date of the notification.

CurrentStatusDateTime.name: Current Status Date Time
CurrentStatusDateTime.definition: Specifies the date and time at which the current status was assigned to the individual trade.

ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Product type of the individual trade.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: Indicate the requested settlement session that the related trade is part of.

RegulatoryReporting.name: Regulatory Reporting
RegulatoryReporting.definition: Information that is to be provided to trade repositories in the context of the regulatory standards around over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives, central counterparties and trade repositories.

NewSettlementDateRule.definition: New Settlement Date is only to be used when there has been an amendment to the settlement date. For example, when there has been a currency calendar amendment or a settlement deferral event.
